scope: SC/AC probes to 10 degrees, sampled at 0.5 degrees and at 0.1 degrees from the last clear sample to the first blocked sample. Go/return exact rigid and eight fixed-end wire envelopes with the shared support and tabletop base. No moving cuff or TPU is tested in the new scapular probes. Anterior displacement is measured at the GH centre, with GH held neutral relative to scapula. Axial labelling uses a synthetic bent elbow marker; rigid motion limits are from the original straight-elbow probes, not the bent probe. Cuff tests evaluate each channel independently, including the local load and unload sequence.
